about: The witness voice contract (WMP-01 A, E3 §A5.2.4). Regex rules live here; structural rules (length, slots, levels, review) are in scripts/voice-lint.mjs. Severity per scope: validation (ValidationLine text), feeling_copy (copy that answers a feeling), user_copy (other app copy). 'report' never fails. Nothing the user writes is ever linted. Lightened 2026-10-01 (Claudia): only no_diagnosis and the structural rules (slots, level 3 shape, reviewed_live) block a load; the rest warn or report. Claudia's own bans live in scripts/witness/content.py.

rules.pattern: \byou're right\b|\bthey were wrong\b|\bit was (unkind|wrong)\b|\bthis was wrong\b|\bthey don't care\b|\bthey meant\b
rules.message: Validate the feeling, never an interpretation or another person's intent.
No cheer on feelings, no exclamation marks.
No emoji in validation or feeling copy.
And, not but: a second clause never takes the first one back.
App lines speak as a witness (you, or the user's name); first person only in lines the user writes.
Never validate the intensity or volume of a feeling (crushing, heavy, furious, massive, extreme, loud…). Validate the trigger and that the feeling is there (Claudia's rule 4).

structural.message: Only {N} {word} {phrase} {need}; textNamed has {N} exactly when voice is name; text never has {N}.
Level 3 is a guess: tentative, with at least one UNDERNEATH emotion.
A live line has been reviewed (reviewStatus reviewed, reviewedAt set).
In a flow that declares step kinds, a receive step precedes any change step.
The receive beat always renders skip, none of these fit and say it my way.
